doc: Age-only Kaplan-Meier hazard per (direction x family). This is the formalized median-half-cycle prior and THE baseline any hazard model (W4.2) must beat to earn ship credit. KM estimator: lambda_t = events_t / at_risk_t. Survival: S(t) = prod_{s<=t}(1 - lambda_s). Wilson CIs on lambda_t per age bucket.
